strings.name: Sheikh Hasina
strings.summary: A daughter of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, Hasina led the Awami League after exile, governing in 1996–2001 and 2009–2024. Development accompanied electoral and rights controversies. She fled to India after the 2024 uprising. In 2025 she received an in-absentia death sentence for crimes against humanity and prison terms totaling 21 years in separate corruption cases. She rejected the proceedings; rights groups raised fair-trial concerns.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Her long premiership, development policies, governance controversies and ouster shaped South Asian politics.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Attended the University of Dhaka and participated in student politics.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Long government leadership
strings.highlights.h1.text: Governed through development, water-sharing and hill-region peace initiatives.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Repression and accountability
strings.highlights.h2.text: The 2024 crackdown led to her ouster and trials, themselves facing fairness concerns.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Prosecutor rejects retrial
strings.timeline.t1.text: The chief prosecutor of Bangladesh’s International Crimes Tribunal said existing law barred retrial on the same charges underlying her death sentence.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Land-case imprisonment
strings.timeline.t2.text: Separate land-allocation corruption cases produced prison sentences totaling 21 years.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Death sentence in absentia
strings.timeline.t3.text: The tribunal convicted her of crimes against humanity; HRW criticized procedure and capital punishment.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Ouster and exile
strings.timeline.t4.text: Left Bangladesh for India after student protests became an anti-government uprising.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Returns as prime minister
strings.timeline.t5.text: Began continuous rule after the 2008 election.
strings.timeline.t6.title: First premiership
strings.timeline.t6.text: Formed government after the Awami League gained a parliamentary plurality.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Returns from exile
strings.timeline.t8.title: Family assassinated
strings.timeline.t8.text: Her parents and brothers were killed while she was abroad, followed by prolonged exile.
